verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a processor, and a built-in task-delegating AI assistant is a software feature, not a capability of a chip. The evidence only says Apple Intelligence models "run at blazing speed" on M4-family hardware. That describes the macOS software layer running on the chip, not an assistant the chip itself ships, so the exception that would make this axis applicable is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
